description: This file defines the ExtractMetadataRetriever class and related classes for extracting metadata from documents using vector stores and language models. It includes class definitions, constructor logic, and methods for retrieving relevant documents based on structured prompts.

classes.name: ExtractMetadataRetriever_Retrievers
classes.description: Implements a retriever node for extracting metadata from queries and documents, supporting structured output and integration with vector stores.

classes.name: DynamicMetadataRetriever
classes.description: A class extending VectorStoreRetriever to dynamically generate filters based on structured LLM responses and retrieve relevant documents.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the retriever with node data and input, configuring structured output and returning the appropriate retriever or documents.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Invokes the structured LLM to generate a filter based on the query.

methods.name: getRelevantDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves documents relevant to the query, applying dynamically generated filters.

methods.name: fromVectorStore
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of DynamicMetadataRetriever from a vector store and options.
